subject: Post-discovery next steps — propose 2 demo rotations & security liaison
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@stratacore.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@stratacore.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery next steps — propose 2 demo rotations & security liaison

Hi Priya / Liam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: we heard you’re focused on reducing inference cost for tenant-level workloads, need predictable 99th pct latency at scale, and want a private/GVPC-friendly deployment option for PHI data. Helpful takeaways:

- Primary use case: customer support triage (batch + low-latency reranking).
- Expected Q1 volume: ~10M tokens/day, burst to 3k rps for search.
- Security/regulatory checkpoint: SOC2 + encrypted-at-rest with key rotation.

Next step: 30-minute product walkthrough (high level + quick infra QA). I can run a compact agenda and include a short ops/security section. Proposed rotations (all times in PT):

1) Tue Oct 12 — 10:00–10:30 PT (convert: 13:00–13:30 ET)
2) Wed Oct 13 — 15:00–15:30 PT (convert: 18:00–18:30 ET)
3) Thu Oct 14 — 09:00–09:30 PT (convert: 12:00–12:30 ET)

Could you pick one slot that works and confirm the stakeholders who should join? In particular, can you loop in your Security Lead (we'll invite our security SME) and the person who owns deployment (infra/DevOps)? That will let us show the dedicated/private options that match your compliance needs.

Attached: security-questionnaire.pdf (high-level answers we often get asked), pre-demo-agenda.xlsx (1-page agenda), mutual-action-plan.docx (starter draft).

If you prefer, we can also run a 45-minute technical deep dive later; this first session is meant to align stakeholders and lock success criteria.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Jordan
